title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Infiniti Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a travel and aviation technology company focused on building robust, cost\-efficient solutions for corporate clients and airlines. The organization has pioneered innovative products in India, including one of the first retail travel portals and web\-based business travel solutions. Infiniti serves over 200 corporates across India and 20 global airlines, reflecting its strong industry presence and customer partnerships. With over 250 motivated team members across four locations in India, the company offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in travel technology and product innovation. Team members are encouraged to contribute to impactful solutions and participate in the company’s ongoing growth.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 The Product Marketing Specialist will be responsible for positioning and promoting Infiniti’s travel and aviation technology products in the market. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai involves developing go\-to\-market strategies, crafting product messaging, and coordinating launch activities with cross\-functional teams such as product management, sales, and customer success. The specialist will analyze market trends, competitive offerings, and customer feedback to refine product value propositions and support sales enablement through presentations, case studies, and marketing collateral. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating on digital campaigns, managing product\-related content for web and sales channels, tracking campaign performance, and preparing regular reports and insights for leadership. The role also includes close engagement with key customers and internal stakeholders to ensure that marketing initiatives align with business objectives and customer needs.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong product marketing skills including go\-to\-market planning, product positioning, and messaging development.
* 3\-6 years of experience in Content Marketing, Digital Marketing or Product Marketing.
* Experience in market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform marketing strategies.
* Ability to create clear, compelling marketing content for digital channels, presentations, and sales collateral.
* Familiarity with digital marketing practices such as campaign management, email marketing, and performance tracking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation and stakeholder management abilities.
* Relevant experience in B2B technology products, preferably in travel, aviation, or SaaS domains.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; advanced certifications in product or digital marketing are a plus.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical skills, proficiency with productivity tools (e.g., MS Office or Google Workspace), and basic familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**Performance Marketer \& Creative Strategist, DTC Brands (Full\-time, Remote)** 




  





**Shaanks · Remote (India) · Full\-time · 2 to 3 years** 




 Shaanks is a creative production agency for DTC brands in skincare, supplements, food and fashion. We make 30 to 40 ad creatives a month for each brand, for clients in India, the US and the UK.
 



  





 Right now our founders decide what those ads should say. We want someone to take that over and run the ads as well.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Go through a brand's Meta Ads Library and their competitors' ads, and work out what's working and what's missing
 



 • Pick the angles and hooks, then write briefs our designers and editors can build from
 



 • Run Meta campaigns for our DTC clients: launch tests, read the numbers, scale the winners and cut the rest
 



 • Tell us which creatives won and why, so the next batch is better
 



 • Help on Google and TikTok when a client asks for it
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 • 2 to 3 years running paid ads yourself. Meta is a must
 



 • DTC or e\-commerce brands on your CV, not only lead gen or B2B
 



 • You can explain in plain words why an ad worked
 



 • Google Ads or TikTok Ads experience is a big plus
 



 • You already use AI tools in your daily work
 



  





**Must\-haves** 




 • A portfolio: case studies, ad results or ads you planned. DTC work preferred. Without one we can't review you
 



 • Full\-time only. No students, interns or part\-time
 



 • You can join soon
 



 • You'll do a 72\-hour test task if shortlisted
 



  





**How it works** 



* Fill the form (about 15 minutes)
* Test task: read a real DTC brand's ads and plan their next 30 days
* Final call with the founders



  





**What you get** 




 • ₹30K to 50K a month, depending on experience. Fully remote
 



 • Indian and international DTC brands from day one
 



 • A creative team shipping 30 to 40 ads a month per brand, so you always have something new to test
 


* • You work directly with the founders

title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Brand Partnerships & Alliances
description:
Matrimony.com Limited is India’s first pure\-play consumer internet company to be listed, with BharatMatrimony recognized as the country’s largest and most trusted matrimony brand. The company offers matchmaking and marriage\-related services across websites, mobile platforms, apps, and over 130 company\-owned retail outlets. Its portfolio includes BharatMatrimony, EliteMatrimony, and CommunityMatrimony, serving diverse communities and customer segments. Matrimony.com is certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting its focus on employee well\-being and an inclusive workplace. Building on its leadership in matchmaking, the company is expanding into the $55 billion marriage services industry via WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com, with an ambition to become a billion\-dollar revenue organization.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Brand Partnerships \& Alliances professional** 
 to support the development and management of a growing brand partnership ecosystem.
 



 The role will primarily focus on building a strong pipeline of prospective brand partners through structured market research, brand identification, decision\-maker mapping and outreach, while also managing the coordination, performance tracking and commercial follow\-up of existing partnerships.
 



 The candidate should be capable of independently identifying relevant brands and the right stakeholders, establishing initial contact and generating qualified meetings.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Brand Research \& Partnership Pipeline** 



* Research and identify potential brand partners across consumer\-facing categories such as Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, Appliances, Travel, Beauty \& Grooming, Furniture, Lifestyle and other relevant sectors.
* Build and maintain category\-wise, city\-wise and state\-wise databases of prospective brands.
* Research brand profiles, geographical presence, store networks and partnership potential.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers across Partnerships, Alliances, Marketing, Business Development and senior management.



**2\. Brand Outreach \& Meeting Generation** 



* Independently reach out to prospective partners through LinkedIn, email, calls, corporate board lines, professional networks and referrals.
* Establish initial conversations with relevant brand stakeholders.
* Generate and schedule qualified meetings with decision\-makers.
* Undertake structured follow\-ups to move conversations forward.
* Maintain an active and measurable partnership pipeline.



**3\. Existing Brand \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate periodic performance and relationship reviews with active brand partners.
* Track partnership performance, customer engagement and other agreed business metrics.
* Coordinate collection and consolidation of relevant partner data.
* Maintain action items from partner reviews and follow through until closure.
* Identify recurring issues or dependencies and escalate them appropriately.



**4\. Commercial \& Payment Coordination** 



* Coordinate with internal teams for partner\-related delivery and performance data.
* Support timely raising and submission of applicable invoices.
* Maintain brand\-wise trackers covering invoices, due dates, payments and outstanding amounts.
* Follow up with partners and internal Finance teams for reconciliation and closure.



**5\. Cross\-functional Coordination** 



* Work closely with Finance, Operations, Product, Marketing and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure brand information, commercials, offers, locations and operational requirements are accurately maintained.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and partner\-related issues.
* Maintain organised records and documentation across partnerships.



**6\. MIS \& Reporting** 



* Maintain a comprehensive partnership dashboard covering the funnel from
 **Target Brand → Decision\-Maker → Outreach → Meeting → Partnership Status → Performance → Invoicing → Collections** 
 .
* Provide weekly updates on prospects, outreach, meetings and pending follow\-ups.
* Prepare periodic performance summaries for active partnerships.
* Maintain clear visibility on ownership, timelines and pending actions.


 Candidate Profile
 * Minimum
 **5 years of relevant professional experience** 
 , preferably in Brand Partnerships, Brand Alliances, Strategic Alliances, Partnerships, Key Account Management or related functions.
* Strong experience in independently researching brands and identifying relevant decision\-makers.
* Hands\-on experience using
 **LinkedIn and professional networks for corporate prospecting and stakeholder mapping** 
 .
* Comfortable with cold outreach, corporate calling and engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple external partners and coordinating with internal teams.
* Experience in
 **Retail, Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, FMCG, E\-commerce, Travel, Lifestyle, Loyalty/Rewards or Gifting** 
 would be an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Management or a related discipline;
 **MBA/PGDM preferred but not mandatory** 
 .


 Key Skills
 
 Strong market research and prospecting skills, excellent communication and networking ability, relationship management, commercial understanding, structured follow\-up, stakeholder management, strong execution and closure orientation, and proficiency in
 **Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and CRM/MIS tools** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be
 **resourceful and network\-oriented** 
 , with the ability to independently identify opportunities, open doors with relevant stakeholders and take partnership conversations from prospecting through execution.

title: Director of Product Management
description:

We will continue to raise the bar every day by investing in our people and technology to help our customers succeed. We hire people who share our passion, bring innovative ideas to the table, and enjoy a collaborative atmosphere.
 



  





**Who we are:** 




 ACV is a technology company that has revolutionized how dealers buy and sell cars online. We are transforming the automotive industry. ACV Auctions Inc. (ACV), has applied innovation and user\-designed, data driven applications and solutions. We are building the most trusted and efficient digital marketplace with data solutions for sourcing, selling and managing used vehicles with transparency and comprehensive insights that were once unimaginable. We are disruptors of the industry and we want you to join us on our journey. Our network of brands include ACV Auctions, ACV Transportation, ClearCar, MAX Digital and ACV Capital within its Marketplace Products, as well as, True360 and Data Services.
 



  





 ACV Auctions in Chennai, India are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As we expand our platform, we're offering a wide range of exciting opportunities across various roles in corporate, operations, and product and technology. Our global product and technology organization spans product management, engineering, data science, machine learning, DevOps and program leadership. What unites us is a deep sense of customer centricity, calm persistence in solving hard problems, and a shared passion for innovation. If you're looking to grow, lead, and contribute to something larger than yourself, we'd love to have you on this journey. Let's build something extraordinary together. Join us in shaping the future of automotive!
 



  





**At ACV we focus on the Health, Physical, Financial, Social and Emotional Wellness of our Teammates and to support this we offer industry leading benefits and wellness programs.** 




  





**What you will do:** 




 We are looking for a senior leader with demonstrated success creating innovative solutions to join ACV Auctions as a Director of Product. As a Director of Product, you will be responsible for the product vision and continued growth and expansion of our offerings as well as managing a team of product and design talent. We’re looking for a unique individual who can be the champion for our company, products and the customers we obsess over daily. This role requires proven understanding of building great product teams and impactful products that can meet our rapidly evolving business needs.
 


* Actively and consistently support all efforts to simplify and enhance the customer experience.
* Data Collection \& Analysis
* Customer Feedback Collection \& Analysis
* Conduct Customer \& Stakeholder Demos
* Own Business Requirements
* Own execution \& delivery of features \& products

* Creation and Presentation of Plans and Impacts

* Lead Agile Ceremonies
* Define Product Lifecycle for your Product Area
* Collaborate with Design, Analysts and Engineering to Plan Development Schedule
* Lead discussions with Technology and Executive Leadership to inform, gain consensus and problem solve
* Develop industry recognition and credibility as a thought leader
* Continuously engage partners and potential partners to look for opportunities to expand our business or make us more efficient and allow us to bring capabilities to market faster
* Manage, Coach and Develop a team of PMs and Analysts
* Delegate responsibilities to your team
* Perform additional duties as assigned



  





**What you will need:** 



* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Proven track record leading product for a portfolio or business area, with responsibility for both strategy and delivery
* Experience building, hiring, and growing product management teams — ideally including establishing or scaling a product practice in a new location or development center
* Experience with CRM, sales, service, or customer\-operations products, or comparable enterprise/workflow domains
* Fluency with AI\-native product workflows, including rapid prototyping
* Business and financial acumen, including building business cases and financial models to present to executives
* Excellent communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across geographies
* Strong customer focus and sound product judgment
* Based in, or willing to be based in, Chennai, India



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience working across US and India teams in a global product organization
* Experience with arbitration, dispute\-resolution, claims, warranty, or assurance/guarantee products
* Automotive or marketplace industry experience
* Experience building platform or API products that other teams build on
* Technical depth, such as prior software engineering experience, fluency querying data with SQL, and comfort reading and reasoning about code



  





  





**Our Values** 




**Trust \& Transparency \| People First \| Positive Experiences \| Calm Persistence \| Never Settling** 




 At ACV, we are committed to an inclusive culture in which every individual is welcomed and empowered to celebrate their true selves. We achieve this by fostering a work environment of acceptance and understanding that is free from discrimination. ACV is committed to being an equal opportunity employer regardless of sex, race, creed, color, religion, marital status, national origin, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, disability, military status, status as a veteran, or any other protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation, please let us know.

**Position Summary:**
 If you are a Project Pursuit professional Iooking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, or Chennai, India, you will play a pivotal role in shaping early\-stage project success by engaging with Global Engineering Centers (GECs) and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) organizations. This role focuses on building strong, trusted relationships and positioning Emerson’s Measurement Solutions portfolio within engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements before procurement begins. You will contribute directly to business growth by influencing project design decisions, strengthening customer partnerships, and enabling innovative, value\-driven solutions across industries.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
* Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
* Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.
* Collaborate across global teams, including sales, marketing, product, and strategic account teams, to align pursuit strategies and deliver customer value.
* Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data\-driven decision\-making and forecasting.
* Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.


**Who You Are:**
 You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. You build partnerships and work collaboratively across teams and functions, sharing knowledge and aligning efforts to achieve shared goals. You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long\-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience required; 10\+ years preferred.
* Experience in industrial automation, process measurement, or related industries, with exposure to EPC or owner\-operator environments.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle, including engineering design, specification development, and procurement processes.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams on technical specifications, vendor qualification, or project pursuit activities.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and deliver engaging presentations or training sessions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and a data\-driven approach to managing pipelines and customer interactions.
* Willingness and ability to travel as part of the role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi\-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with strategic or major account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Experience working with or within EPC organizations or Global Engineering Centers.
* Knowledge of Measurement Solutions technologies (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical, or systems) or similar product portfolios.
* Exposure to industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, or industrial manufacturing.
* Experience with engineering tools or platforms used for specification and design (e.g., SmartPlant, AVEVA).
* Demonstrated ability to work across global teams and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting global approved vendor list qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, or licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.


**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About the role** 




 The Love Hope Company (TLHC) is an integrated mental health ecosystem in Chennai spanning four verticals — Book a Couch (adult therapy), FourCups (children \& families), Love Hope Academy (practitioner training) and Love Hope Community (events \& peer support) — with Love Hope Foundation and Love Hope Studio now scaling alongside them. Today, every marketing decision from brand tone, campaign strategy, content approval, paid ad direction routes through the Founder. This role exists to end that. The Senior Marketing Manager becomes the strategic owner of TLHC's brand voice and organic growth engine across all verticals, so the Founder can step back from day\-to\-day approvals and focus on running the business.
 



  





**What you'll own** 




 • Brand standard — across BAC, FourCups, LHA, Community, Foundation and Studio, in partnership with the Founder and become the reference point the rest of the team checks against instead of escalating to her.
 



 • Content calendar — spanning organic social, blogs/SEO,AEO, GEO, email/WhatsApp nurture, and event/workshop promotion sequencing content across verticals so nothing collides or cannibalizes attention.
 



 • Team — directly manage the Social Media Manager and Content Writer; direct Creative (design) on priorities and briefs; coordinate with the Coordination/Events function so promo content lines up with real event timelines.
 



 • Paid media oversight — TLHC runs paid ads through freelancers. You won't execute campaigns yourself, but you will read performance, sanity\-check spend and targeting, brief freelancers on messaging/creative direction so paid and organic stay one coherent voice, and flag when paid results don't match what organic engagement is telling us about the audience.
 



 • Reporting — own monthly reporting on organic KPIs — reach, saves, shares, inbound DMs/inquiries, referral\-attributed conversions and present it to the Founder as a strategy review, not a status update.
 



 • Campaigns \& collabs — plan and brief content/promo support for workshops, launches and collaborations (e.g. the Neuberg Diagnostics partnership, LHA cohort launches, Foundation campaigns) alongside the events/coordination function.
 



  





**What we need from you** 




 • Experience — 3–5 years in marketing, with real ownership of a brand or content engine — ideally at a D2C, startup, healthcare or wellness\-adjacent company. We're more interested in something you built from near\-zero than a channel you managed inside an existing machine.
 



 • Working knowledge of paid media — comfortable reading Meta/Google Ads dashboards, briefing and holding freelancers accountable, and translating ad performance into plain\-language direction — you don't need to be a performance marketer yourself, but you can't be intimidated by the numbers.
 



 • Judgment — you can push back on the Founder, not just execute her taste. If you only do what you're told, you haven't removed the bottleneck — you've added a relay.
 



 • Tone sensitivity — mental health content has almost no tolerance for generic “wellness” positivity\-speak. TLHC's whole differentiation is that it doesn't perform wellness, it redefines it. We need someone who feels that distinction instinctively, not someone who defaults to soft, vague “journey” language.
 



 • People management — proven experience hiring, briefing and managing a small creative/content team. 
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 • First 30 days: brand\-standard doc live and being used; content calendar running across all verticals without daily Founder input; freelancer paid\-ads relationship transitioned to you.
 



 • By month 6: Founder approval needed only for brand\-defining moments (major launches, founder\-voice content, crisis comms) — everything else runs through you.

 Customer Marketing \& Advocacy (Retention/Expansion \+ Proof)
 


* Stand up Customer Marketing as a true function: operating cadence, KPI framework, and clear alignment across Customer Experience, Account Management, Product Marketing, and Product.
* Build a sales\-ready customer reference program (matching, scheduling, tracking, customer recognition) that reduces time\-to\-reference.
* Launch a referral program that turns happy customers into predictable introductions (clear qualification criteria \+ simple rewards).
* Capture customer outcomes quickly and consistently (lightweight story capture and proof points to support campaigns, sales, and market leadership claims).
* Partner with AM/CX to launch lifecycle plays that drive expansion (usage nudges, add\-on prompts, QBR/ROI packaging).
* Coordinate onboarding communications and adoption motions across teams to improve activation, onboarding speed, and onboarding NPS.
* Own a closed\-loop NPS/CSAT rhythm (collection → insights → actions → follow\-up), ensuring customers see their feedback drive action.



  





**Field Marketing \& Experiences (Pipeline \+ Content)** 



* Own the FY26 events and experiences operating plan aligned to Roofing pipeline goals and content needs.
* Operationalize a monthly “Roofing Momentum” go\-live celebration \+ local meetup series that improves customer experience while generating local demand.
* Run a monthly webinar program with strong conversion paths (demo bookings \+ nurture).
* Execute a Roofing\-first field event portfolio (regional \+ national) with a focus on consistent pipeline creation and healthy unit economics.
* Implement an event measurement \+ follow\-up SLA (lead capture → routing → outreach → SAL) in partnership with Sales/RevOps.
* Work with Partner Marketing on co\-event motions (co\-hosted webinars or in\-person activations) to drive Partner/Alliances pipeline.
* Support production of our regular “Raise the Roof” Facebook livestream events by managing guest roster, run\-of\-show planning, and assets.



  





**Scale Through Systems \+ AI** 



* Use AI and templates to increase throughput (event comms, run\-of\-show, segmentation drafts, nurture copy, landing pages, post\-event reporting, VOC synthesis) without increasing headcount.
* Build repeatable playbooks so programs become easier and more scalable over time.



  





**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERS YOU’LL WORK WITH** 




 Customer Experience, Account Management, Partner Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Product.
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (EXAMPLES OF METRICS)** 



* Roofing Momentum program running monthly with consistent attendance, customer advocacy participation, and measurable pipeline influence.
* Reduced time\-to\-reference and increased reference utilization by Sales.
* Predictable referral\-driven introductions from qualified customer advocates.
* Webinar and field event programs generating demo bookings and pipeline at target unit economics.
* Documented event measurement and follow\-up SLA with improving conversion to Sales Qualified Lead.
* Increased volume and velocity of customer proof assets (short clips, quotes, mini\-stories) used by Sales and Marketing.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 5\+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including meaningful ownership in two or more of: customer marketing/advocacy, field marketing/events, lifecycle/retention marketing, community, partner marketing.
* Proven ability to run programs end\-to\-end: strategy → planning → execution → measurement → iteration.
* Strong event execution chops (webinars, meetups, field events) with a bias toward measurable pipeline outcomes.
* Strong writing/storytelling skills: customer comms, event comms, proof points, nurture messaging.
* Comfort using AI tools and templates to scale output and move faster.
* Highly organized operator: able to manage a calendar of recurring programs and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Seattle\-area residency (required) and ability to host local activations; willingness to travel monthly for regional/national events.



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Experience marketing to roofing \& exteriors, trades, field service, or similar SMB industry verticals.
* Experience building customer advocacy programs (references, referrals, community) from the ground up.
* Experience partnering closely with Sales/RevOps on lead routing, attribution, and SLAs.



  





**TRAVEL** 



* Expected travel is monthly and program\-dependent (e.g., local/regional/national events, VIP dinners/roundtables, customer roadshows).

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Manager - Regional Product development
description:

 To introduce the right regional products by generating an in\-depth understanding of cultural, ritualistic and community specific requirements for jewelry and by undertaking extensive indexing of relevant competition.  1\. Mapping the current universe of regional products

 1\. Monthly visits to regional competition to benchmark the regional products offered, weight bands, making charge ...etc.
 



 2\. Synthesis of actionable insights and incorporation into the Range plan

title: GTM Architect
description:
**ABOUT JMAN:** 




 JMAN Group is a fast\-growing data engineering \& data science consultancy. We work primarily with Private Equity Funds and their Portfolio Companies to create commercial value using Data \& Artificial Intelligence. In addition, we also work with growth businesses, large corporates, multinationals, and charities.
 



  





 We are headquartered in London with Offices in New York, London and Chennai. Our team of over 450 people is a unique blend of individuals with skills across commercial consulting, data science and software engineering.
 



  





 We were founded by cousins Anush Newman (Co\-founder \& CEO) and Leo Valan (Co\-founder \& CTO) and have grown rapidly since 2019\. In May 2023 we took a minority investment from Baird Capital and in January 2024 we opened an office in New York with the ambition of growing our US business to be as large as, if not bigger than, our European business by 2027\.
 



  





**Why work at JMAN:** 




 Our vision is to ensure JMAN Group is the passport to our team’s future. We want our team to go on a fast\-paced, high\-growth journey with us – when our people want to do something else, the skills, training, exposure, and values that JMAN has instilled in them should open doors all over the world.
 



 Current Benefits:
 



 − Competitive annual bonus
 



 − Market\-leading private health insurance
 



 − Regular company socials
 



 − Annual company away days
 



 − Extensive training opportunities
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The GTM Architect will be the strategic bridge between JMAN product and delivery capabilities and our global client client partners (US/UK), driving sales enablement, value creation, and delivery alignment for the Private Equity and portfolio client ecosystem.
 



  





 While the primary focus is on sales enablement and value creation, this role will also oversee delivery management for active accounts to ensure solution promises translate into client outcomes.
 



  





 This position is ideal for senior professionals with technology presales experience with a MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School who can combine commercial acumen, solution storytelling, and operational discipline to scale our go\-to\-market efforts.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 5–10 years in technology presales, GTM, or solution consulting roles in tech services, consulting, or SaaS/product firms.
* MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School (like, IIM, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, Great Lakes etc.) with strong exposure to GTM, consulting, or tech solutioning.
* Good understanding of Private Equity ecosystem and portfolio value creation levers (preferred).
* Proven ability to design value propositions linking solutions to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Ability to articulate impactful solution presentations.
* Experience in managing or overseeing delivery teams to ensure alignment with GTM objectives.
* Exposure to data, analytics, cloud, or AI\-led solutions is a plus.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Enablement \& Solution Readiness
 *(Core Focus)***



* Develop solution playbooks, value propositions, and proposal templates tailored for PE and portfolio clients.
* Partner with US/UK Client Partners to craft impactful client pitches, proposal response and data \& AI solution narratives.
* Lead solutioning workshops with Delivery, Labs, and CoEs for cross\-functional GTM alignment.
* Maintain a centralized repository of sales assets, proof points, and case studies.



**Value Creation Strategy
 *(Core Focus)***



* Map JMAN’s data \& AI solution offerings to portfolio business value drivers (e.g. top\-line growth, margin improvement, operational efficiency, etc).
* Quantify and articulate ROI outcomes for client proposals.
* Contribute to strategic account plans and market expansion strategies.



**Delivery Management
 *(Supporting Focus)***



* Work with Tech Delivery Leads and PMO to monitor project progress for strategic accounts.
* Ensure delivery outputs align with agreed solution value propositions, and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to expand accounts through insights from delivery engagements.



**Global GTM Collaboration \& Governance** 



* Serve as the India\-based GTM anchor for global pursuits, ensuring quick turnaround and time zone coverage.
* Align with Marketing to drive campaigns and thought leadership tied to target accounts.
* Support PMO with pipeline tracking, conversion analytics, and win\-loss reviews.
* Run bi\-weekly GTM huddles with US/UK partners to review opportunity pipeline.

* Represent Metayb at conferences, webinars, customer forums, and industry events.
* Drive executive thought leadership through articles, research reports, podcasts, webinars, and speaking engagements.
* Position Metayb as a trusted advisor in Digital Transformation and Marketing Consulting.
* Practice Operations \& Leadership

* Define KPIs and dashboards to measure marketing effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and business impact.
* Manage budgets, resource planning, capability development, and operational excellence.
* Foster collaboration across Sales, Delivery, Technology, HR, Finance, and Leadership teams.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Brand Strategy, Growth Marketing, or Marketing Consulting within IT Services, Consulting, SaaS, or Digital Transformation organizations.

 system improvements.

title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

title: Innovation Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




 We invite you to join the ZEISS Innovation Hub Chennai to shape together with us the future of advanced frugal innovation. We are turning today’s research into tomorrow’s applications – together with academic partners, students and entrepreneurs. Located at the IIT Madras Research Park, you will work in direct neighborhood to a world\-leading universities and with many startups co\-located in this dynamic environment. You will:
 



 • Drive new topics under the umbrella of advanced frugal innovation, by identifying and evaluating opportunities in the innovation sweet spot of desirability, feasibility, and viability
 



 • Find and work with partners in these topics in close cooperation with ZEISS stakeholders
 



 • Conduct innovation and market studies, identify customer needs, and develop solution concepts as part of an interdisciplinary team
 



 • Initiate and steer projects (incl. external partners) in the development of novel solutions (e.g., proof\-of\-concept demonstrators) and ensure the transfer of relevant knowhow to ZEISS
 



 • Support the successful transfer of concepts, technologies, and solutions to ZEISS business units
 



 • Screen and evaluate startups with strategic relevance for the Inno Hub's topics
 



 • Develop new business and venturing proposals and ideally lead your topic through incubation with our internal venture unit
 



  





 ZEISS employees work in a place where expert knowledge and team spirit reign supreme. All of this is supported by a special ownership structure and the long\-term goal of the Carl Zeiss Foundation: to bring science and society into the future together.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 



1. Ideally looking for 8\-12 years of relevant experience, can extend to 17 years.

5. Ideally experience in innovation management or (internal) venturing, relevant methodologies such as design thinking, business models, lean startup, and software’s such as Miro, Power BI, Sharp cloud etc. for visualizing idea funnels
6. An intrapreneurial mindset, a holistic view of innovation and a desire to take topics beyond technology to market success
7. Experience in project management
8. A “together we go far” (collaboration) and “just do it” (action\-bias) mindset
9. Passion for innovation and enthusiasm for new technologies as well as fun working in agile, interdisciplinary, and cross\-border teams
10. Ability to persevere in the process of idea creation and rejection, with a positive mindset

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About SuperOps** 




 SuperOps is building the AI\-native platform for modern IT management unifying PSA and RMM into a single, agent\-first system that enables IT teams and MSPs to run and scale their operations with dramatically less manual effort. We are backed by Addition Partners, March Capital, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital, and Tanglin Venture Partners
 



  





 SuperOps is looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the full marketing infrastructure \- from the systems and automation that power our campaigns to the data and attribution layer that tells us what's working. This is a high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and technology.
 



 You will own everything: HubSpot infrastructure, lead lifecycle and scoring, multi\-touch attribution, AI\-native workflows, campaign operations, SDR enablement, and the reporting systems that keep the revenue team aligned. You won't just manage tools \- you'll build systems that diagnose problems, surface insights, and keep the pipeline moving.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Marketing Operations Strategy and Operating Model** 



* Build and own the Marketing Operations roadmap, operating model and quarterly priorities.
* Create a clear intake and prioritisation process so the function focuses on work with measurable pipeline or efficiency impact.
* Establish documentation, change\-management and continuity standards for critical systems and workflows.
* Partner with Marketing, RevOps, SDR leadership and Finance on shared definitions, processes and service\-level agreements.



**Marketing Systems and Lifecycle** 



* Own and continuously improve HubSpot's marketing architecture, including properties, workflows, segmentation, campaign structures, lifecycle automation and integrations.
* Define and maintain lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, lead and account scoring, nurture paths, routing and SDR handoffs in partnership with RevOps.
* Improve data quality through reliable enrichment, deduplication, field standards, governance and exception monitoring across contact and company records.
* Create documentation, change\-control practices and service\-level agreements that make critical processes reliable and easy to operate.
* Monitor routing performance and SLA adherence, using SDR feedback to improve lead and account quality over time.



**GTM Intelligence and Market Research** 



* Build and maintain the target\-account universe for IT and mid\-market segments, with clear ICP tiers, verticals, regions, use cases and buying groups.
* Run the Marketing Research Engine (MRE) as a repeatable intelligence process that produces campaign\-ready and SDR\-ready audiences not one\-off lists.
* Combine fit, engagement, intent and timing sign signals to prioritise accounts and recommend the appropriate nurture, campaign or SDR action.
* Use campaign outcomes and SDR feedback to improve data sources, segments, scoring models and targeting decisions over time.
* Evaluate enrichment and intelligence tools based on coverage, accuracy, cost and measurable impact on pipeline generation.



**Measurement, Attribution and Planning** 



* Own Marketing's metrics layer and data dictionary, including lifecycle definitions, sourcing, influence and pipeline contribution.
* Build practical attribution and reporting across inbound, outbound, paid, events, partners and account\-based programs.
* Translate funnel, campaign, channel and account performance into recommendations on audience, investment and next\-best action.
* Partner with Growth, RevOps and Finance on trusted dashboards, budget\-versus\-actual reporting, forecasting and data\-quality controls.



**Campaign Operations and Enablement** 



* Turn audience and campaign strategy into scalable, measurable programs with Growth, Segment Marketing and Demand Generation.
* Standardise campaign setup, taxonomy, UTMs, lists, forms, nurture, routing, QA and post\-campaign reporting.
* Build reusable playbooks for webinars, events, content, paid, partner and targeted\-account programs.
* Support Web and Growth teams with form architecture, conversion tracking and experiment instrumentation.
* Equip SDR teams with prioritised audiences, campaign context, timely alerts and feedback loops while keeping sales execution with SDR leadership.



**AI\-Enabled Automation** 



* Identify, pilot and scale AI\-enabled workflows for research, enrichment, qualification, routing, campaign QA, reporting and operational insight.
* Build practical automations in HubSpot, n8n and related tools; partner with technical teams when a solution requires custom APIs or data infrastructure.
* Apply appropriate human review, monitoring, fallback paths and documentation so automation remains accurate, safe and maintainable.
* Measure adoption, accuracy, hours saved, workflow reliability and business impact rather than tool usage alone.



**What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months** 



* Publish a prioritised Marketing Operations roadmap with clear ownership, service levels and dependencies.
* Standardise lifecycle stages, qualification, routing and SDR handoffs, with visible exception and SLA reporting.
* Establish an account\-level mid\-market data model with ICP tiers, scoring signals and buying\-group coverage.
* Launch a trusted full\-funnel reporting view that connects campaign and channel investment to pipeline outcomes.
* Put two or more AI\-enabled or automated workflows into regular use with measurable gains in speed, quality or decision\-making.



  





**What You Bring** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 6\+ years of B2B marketing operations, revenue operations or GTM operations experience, ideally in SaaS.
* Deep hands\-on HubSpot expertise across workflows, lifecycle management, segmentation, scoring, reporting and integrations.
* Experience designing lead\-to\-revenue processes in a sales\-led or hybrid motion involving Marketing, SDRs and Account Executives.
* Strong command of funnel metrics, attribution, campaign taxonomy, UTM governance and pipeline reporting.

title: Social Media Marketing Specialist
description:

 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. We have grown into a close\-knit family of
 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.

 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services**

 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Social Media Marketing Specialist** 
 to drive Metayb’s digital presence across
 **B2B and B2C audiences** 
 .
   

  

 The role will focus on strengthening
 **brand awareness, growing online communities, driving social engagement, building employee advocacy, supporting lead generation, and executing digital and AI\-led campaigns** 
 across relevant social media platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with
 **Meta platforms and advertising tools** 
 , social media analytics, content\-led campaigns, influencer collaborations, e\-commerce platforms such as
 **Shopify** 
 , and tracking technologies such as
 **Meta Pixel and conversion tracking** 
 . The candidate should be comfortable using data and insights to optimise campaigns and improve brand and business outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Social Media \& Brand Management
   

  

* Develop and execute social media strategies across B2B and B2C audiences to strengthen brand awareness and digital presence.
* Manage and grow Metayb’s presence across platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant social channels.
* Plan and maintain an effective social media content calendar aligned with brand, business, campaign, and marketing objectives.
* Create and execute campaigns focused on brand awareness, reach, engagement, community growth, and lead generation.
* Monitor social media trends, platform updates, audience behaviour, and emerging content formats to identify opportunities for growth.
* Maintain consistency in brand messaging, tone, visual communication, and digital presence across social platforms.


 🔹 Community Growth \& Social Engagement
   

  

* Build, manage, and grow relevant online communities around the brand, products, services, and industry.
* Drive meaningful conversations and engagement with followers, prospects, customers, partners, and industry audiences.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and social conversations and ensure timely and appropriate engagement.
* Develop initiatives to improve community participation, follower quality, engagement rates, and brand affinity.
* Identify relevant conversations, industry trends, and topical opportunities to increase organic visibility.
* Track community and engagement performance and continuously identify opportunities for improvement.


 🔹 Employee Advocacy \& Employer Branding
   

  

* Develop and execute employee advocacy programmes to encourage employees to actively engage with and amplify Metayb’s content.
* Create campaigns and initiatives that enable employees to become authentic brand ambassadors across social platforms.
* Collaborate with HR and internal teams to support employer branding, employee engagement, hiring campaigns, and workplace storytelling.
* Develop content initiatives that showcase employee experiences, expertise, achievements, events, and organisational culture.
* Track employee advocacy performance and identify opportunities to increase organic brand reach.


 🔹 Paid Social Media \& Meta Marketing
   

  

* Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta platforms including Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage campaigns across objectives such as awareness, engagement, traffic, conversions, remarketing, and lead generation.
* Work hands\-on with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite, Meta Audience tools, Ads Reporting, and campaign optimisation tools.
* Develop and test different audiences, creatives, ad formats, messaging, placements, and campaign strategies.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimise budgets based on CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, conversions, ROAS, and other relevant metrics.
* Implement and monitor Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, events, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through A/B testing and data\-driven optimisation.


 🔹 AI\-Led Campaigns \& Digital Marketing
   

  

* Support the development and execution of AI\-led marketing campaigns across social and digital channels.
* Explore and leverage AI tools for content creation, campaign ideation, audience insights, personalisation, creative development, and marketing automation.
* Experiment with AI\-driven content formats and campaigns to improve engagement, reach, and lead generation.
* Stay updated on emerging AI marketing tools, generative AI capabilities, social media trends, and automation opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams to translate AI and technology capabilities into engaging social media campaigns and digital narratives.


 🔹 Influencer \& Partnership Marketing
   

  

* Identify and collaborate with relevant influencers, creators, industry experts, thought leaders, and digital communities.
* Develop and execute influencer campaigns aligned with brand awareness, engagement, community growth, and lead\-generation objectives.
* Manage influencer outreach, campaign coordination, content requirements, timelines, and performance tracking.
* Evaluate influencer and creator performance based on reach, engagement, audience relevance, conversions, and campaign outcomes.
* Build long\-term relationships with relevant creators and industry communities.


 🔹 E\-Commerce \& Conversion Tracking
   

  

* Manage and support social media campaigns for e\-commerce and digital commerce platforms, including Shopify and similar platforms.
* Develop campaigns that drive website traffic, product discovery, customer engagement, and conversions.
* Work with Shopify and other e\-commerce platforms to support campaign tracking, landing pages, product promotions, and conversion journeys.
* Implement and monitor Meta Pixel, events, conversion APIs/hooks, and other relevant tracking mechanisms.
* Work closely with web, product, and marketing teams to ensure accurate tracking of campaign performance and customer journeys.
* Analyse campaign and website data to identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and customer acquisition.


 🔹 Lead Generation \& Analytics
   

  

* Plan and execute social media initiatives focused on qualified lead generation across B2B and B2C segments.
* Work closely with sales and marketing teams to align social media campaigns with business and lead\-generation objectives.
* Track and analyse reach, impressions, engagement, traffic, leads, conversions, CPL, CAC, and campaign ROI.
* Prepare regular social media and campaign performance reports with actionable insights.
* Use analytics and audience data to refine content strategy, targeting, campaign messaging, and channel performance.
* Continuously test and optimise campaigns to improve overall marketing effectiveness.


 🔹 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, HR, Product, Creative, Technology, and Business teams to develop relevant social media campaigns.
* Work with creative teams to develop social media creatives, videos, reels, campaign assets, and other digital content.
* Translate business objectives and product/service propositions into compelling social media communication.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution of campaigns, launches, events, and announcements.
* Support digital marketing initiatives across both B2B and B2C business segments.
* Stay informed about competitor activity and industry trends to identify relevant opportunities for Metayb.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 4–5 years of experience in Social Media Marketing, Digital Marketing, Social Media Management, or a related role.
* Proven experience managing social media campaigns across B2B and B2C environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Meta platforms, paid social campaigns, social analytics, and lead\-generation campaigns.
* Experience with Shopify or other e\-commerce platforms is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign optimisation.
* Experience working with influencers, creators, online communities, and employee advocacy programmes.
* Exposure to AI\-led marketing campaigns and AI\-powered marketing/content tools.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
* Strong understanding of B2B and B2C social media marketing.
* Experience in brand awareness, community growth, social engagement, and lead generation.
* Strong knowledge of paid social media, audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign optimisation.
* Hands\-on understanding of Meta Pixel, conversion events, tracking, and analytics.
* Working knowledge of Shopify and e\-commerce marketing platforms.
* Experience with influencer marketing and creator collaborations and should have experience with Canva app.
* Experience building and managing employee advocacy initiatives.
* Knowledge of AI tools and AI\-led digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of social media analytics, performance metrics, A/B testing, and campaign reporting.
* Ability to develop content strategies based on audience insights, trends, and business objectives.
* Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Creative and data\-driven approach to social media marketing with strong attention to brand consistency and campaign performance.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast\-paced digital environment.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Business Head
description:
**Role Objective:**

 **end\-to\-end P\&L ownership**

 **market expansion, customer acquisition, product portfolio, technology, operations, manufacturing, quality, supply chain and people** 
 , while strengthening profitability and building a scalable organization for sustainable long\-term growth.

 **existing customers, new customers, new products, geographies and emerging applications** 
 .

**P\&L Ownership \& Financial Performance** 



* Own the complete
 **P\&L of the Mechatronics business**

 **product mix, pricing, localization, cost engineering, productivity and operational excellence** 
 .
